articles.title_en: Former Russian governor gets 14-year prison sentence for taking bribes tied to border fortifications
articles.lead_en: A court in Kursk has sentenced former regional Governor Alexei Smirnov to 14 years in a maximum-security prison and fined him 400 million rubles, the regional court’s press service said.

articles.title_en: Murmansk governor confirms Russian general killed in An-26 crash in Crimea
articles.lead_en: Murmansk Governor Andrei Chibis has confirmed that Lieutenant General Alexander Otroshchenko was among those killed when an An-26 military transport plane crashed in Russian-occupied Crimea on March 31. There were no survivors.
